study.question: After preserving the full incumbent, does exact empirical dependence between category-brand bucket identity X and action/coarse-age bundle Y within target-match groups add useful information beyond their separate empirical distributions?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent pools fields and independent content/context embedding moments, retains action-age histograms and category-brand concentration separately, but is invariant (up to numerical summation) to reassigning whole action/age bundles among complete-pair events within a target-match group. An exact identity-context entropy/collision summary can distinguish such histories. This information may predict clicks even though learned eventwise product alternatives failed. The predictive value is unestablished; restoring a distinction is not proof that it helps. Measured seed-42 context: parent joint identity AUC 0.6204259428 versus independent 0.6200901343, marginal 0.6202694348 and zero 0.6200937865. Parent identity head differs from marginal by only +0.0001565080 AUC and worsens Logloss (0.1957507993 versus 0.1955983188); neither repeatability nor a population dependence mechanism is established. First-512 candidate-supplied diagnostics report mean complete history 118.115 and 85.156% at limit; these are bounded probes, not population statistics. Available baseline references already succeeded on host (static 0.6050036145, pooled 0.6102261137, DIN-style 0.6133619861). Raw physical data and Torch are not exported here; initial reproducibility verification is source-hash/API/receipt based, not an independent rerun of data gates or training.

nearest_work.difference: Parent source d70d955ee6e60a898a56a015f9da9460a02a22d37d54c4098bd8a7c818a56d2c verified against candidate.py and history_g1_r0012_joint_identity.py. Inherits entire extractor and category-brand entropy/collision residual. New variable is coupling of the already-paired identity to action-age context, not category-brand pairing itself.

Previous eventwise learned energy/product summaries did not beat pooled parent (AUC 0.619705 vs 0.620094); this is counterevidence against a universal event-pairing benefit. New readout uses exact discrete contingency entropy/collision without learned per-event products; it is appended rather than replacing field norm/means.

Earlier action-age contingency preserves the relation between action and age within match groups but loses which category-brand identity carried that bundle. Its slight gain over factorization is local single-seed evidence only.

inherited_components: All parent embeddings, dormant attention, output head, exact feature construction, independent content/context moments, observed action-age histogram and norm-collapsed field readout
Entire 464-parameter category-brand identity head in joint mode; same scratch parameter shapes and allocation order
Frozen supplied causal prefix L<=128, target-match partitions, existing 1h/1d/7d coarse age boundaries and type 1..4
Natural class ratio, host loss/optimizer, epochs=3, batch=4096, seed=42, full train/validation boundaries
Generic bias-free residual head with zero last weight, and existing sorted run-count entropy/collision algorithm
study.proposed_difference: Append a second bias-free 28->16->1 ReLU residual head after all parent allocations (+464 parameters). On identical mask & category>0 & brand>0 support within each of four target-match groups, reuse parent H(X), collision(X), n; compute 16-cell Y=(action,coarse age) counts and sorted (X,Y) run counts. Common coordinates are log1p(n)/log129, H(X)/log129, H(Y)/log129, collision(X), collision(Y); final two are either empirical H(X,Y)/log129 and collision(X,Y), or analytic empirical-product H(X)+H(Y) and collision(X)*collision(Y), or zeros. Zero control zeros all 28 coordinates. All four cells compute all alternatives before selection. No new event information, sequence ordering, loss or optimizer. This is a local mechanism contrast; entropy/count features and residual heads are established generic tools, and global novelty is unverified.
predictions: Algebra: both histories of a four-event witness have identical parent features, original identity features, context and identity marginals, but coupled H differs by log(2) and collision by 0.25; independent/marginal readouts are identical.

Coupled versus independent is the primary information contrast. A validation AUC advantage >=0.0001 is a preliminary signal worth paired repetitions only if marginal and zero controls do not account for it; no significance claim from seed 42.

Context-bundle reversal on complete-pair support preserves common/product summaries and parent features up to floating-point error while it can alter empirical joint summaries; full event reversal and bijective identity relabeling preserve all summary values.

A useful efficient candidate should remain <=1.25 times incumbent measured wall and inference cost; report actual frontier, parameters, host GPU/memory/latency rather than assume equal compute from matched epochs.

Report full-population AUC, unweighted Logloss and frozen slices with sample/positive/negative counts; the parent Logloss 0.1957508 is worse than marginal-identity 0.1955983, so an AUC improvement does not imply calibration improvement.
falsifiers: Any wrong support, masked/missing contribution, nonfinite logits/gradients/diagnostics, key overflow, sorted/dense disagreement beyond float tolerance, or failed invariance invalidates implementation evidence and requires correction before interpretation.
If coupled fails to exceed independent and marginal controls on matched runs, the claimed predictive value is unsupported; mere sensitivity to reassignment is insufficient.
If only common or product coordinates help, attribute gain to marginal feature access/capacity/optimization, not observed identity-context coupling.
If improvements disappear or reverse across paired seeds or are offset by measured cost/calibration deterioration, do not promote the coupling mechanism as supported.
A null finding refutes only this coarse joint-entropy/collision readout under this protocol, not all event-level models or all identity/context dependence.
alternative_explanations: High-cardinality finite-sample entropy and collision reflect n, support richness or rare-cell bias rather than useful dependence. Empirical plug-in entropy is not a population mutual-information estimator.
Added residual capacity and duplicate nonlinear access to existing marginals may explain gains; independent/marginal/zero controls address this, but effective rank/input scaling still differs.
Optimization coupling changes learned parent parameters even with identical initial parent allocation and zero initial new residual. Equal allocated capacity does not mean equal effective capacity.
Coarse age binning and dominant pv events may wash out the relevant pattern; a failed readout need not refute a finer action/recency mechanism.
Seed noise, many earlier adaptive validation comparisons and slice multiplicity limit inference; first-512 diagnostics are implementation probes, not population effect estimates.
Category-brand buckets can group several real items; frozen 128-event censoring and static snapshot dates limit generalization.

Latest knowledge usage is documented with no undocumented industry IDs, but its used DMR entry operationalized field constraints rather than an architecture. The executed identity gains do not establish that reading the source caused the improvement; industry adoption remains considered, not supported transfer.

cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 22,000s conservatively for up to twelve frozen-suite full validation runs (four models x seeds 42,43,44); allow reuse only when hashes/protocol/seed match. Validation only: no test requests or closed-archive reads. Leaves about 9,419s for charged preparation/other work before accounting current elapsed costs.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not train locally or install Torch. Submit 4 standalone modules and proposal only. Host enforces cap; no duplicate unknown-state calls. Stop if current remaining budget cannot fit a complete admissible suite plus reserves, if integrity checks fail, or hard budget is reached. Keep all failed receipts; do not raise limits. Freeze later selection and repetition suite before any authorized final validation; do not claim assessment or success from a proposal.
